summary: From a blank file you add a provider, an address and a model name to your settings, one function that builds the client, tests that need no server, and a real run of the same API with the stand-in and with a local model. The metrics table names the model, and it shows a bug: the example API prices were charged to a model that has no per-token fee.
goal: M14: switch providers by configuration only.

items.text: Decide on paper which setting says who answers and where the choice is made
Add the provider, address and model settings with clear errors
Write one function that picks the client and use it in get_writer
Write the tests with a fake transport and see them pass with mypy clean
Run the API with the stand-in and with the local model and ask the same two questions
Query the requests table and fix the cost column for a local model
Play the Provider Switch game to the end and see your score
